title: Proclamation by Adriana, Captain of the Guard

entities.name: Adriana
entities.description: The stripped captain of the guard of Paliano who carries Brago's sword and calls on the citizens to defy the usurper queen.

entities.name: Marchesa
entities.description: The new queen, whom Adriana calls a known assassin and plotter who murdered King Brago and forged her claim.

entities.name: King Brago
entities.description: The immortal king of Paliano whom Adriana says was murdered by Marchesa.

entities.name: Custodi
entities.description: The priests who once made the king's word manifest and now back Marchesa.

entities.name: Paliano
entities.description: The city whose free citizens Adriana addresses.

entities.name: Brago's sword
entities.description: The blade bearing the symbol of the city on its pommel, which Adriana now carries.

entities.name: City Troops
entities.description: The soldiers of the city whose banners have already changed to Marchesa's sigil.

events.summary: Adriana tells the citizens they awoke as unwitting traitors under the banner of a usurper queen, Marchesa.
events.quote: You awoke as unwitting traitors beneath the bloodstained banner of a usurper queen

events.summary: Adriana accuses Marchesa of murdering King Brago and forging his will and of commanding the Custodi.
events.quote: Somehow, this vile deceiver murdered King Brago

events.summary: Adriana notes that the City Troops' banners have changed and that Marchesa avoids the city's symbol.
events.quote: But the banners of the City Troops have already changed.

events.summary: Adriana declares she carries Brago's sword and, though stripped of her title, will not relinquish her duty to defend the city from the usurper.
events.quote: I know this because I now carry that sword

events.summary: Adriana urges the citizens to stand with her and Brago and disobey the pretender.
events.quote: stand with me, and with Brago, and show your loyalty to your city through your disobedience to the pretender.

relations.note: Adriana vows to unseat the usurper.
relations.quote: I have no wish to rule, only to unseat the usurper

relations.note: Adriana accuses her of murdering the king.
relations.quote: Somehow, this vile deceiver murdered King Brago

relations.note: Adriana says she commands the Custodi's loyalty.
relations.quote: Somehow, she commands the loyalty of the Custodi priests
